text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! Didn't I do pretty well out 
there...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
With a result like this in a GⅠ... the way 
everyone looks at me will surely—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Cityyyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Did everyone see that? My run—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You looked so gorgeous when you were 
running! City, you're the best~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So that's Gold City. It's my first time 
seeing her, but the way she runs has such 
incredible flair, it's great.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, she was gorgeous...! How can 
someone be dripping with sweat and still 
look like pure "beauty"!? Models are 
amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Pretty"? What's that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, it's just about my looks? 
Is that all I'm worth to people...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Cityyy!! Look over heeeere!!" acknowledge

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Hmm... You've got good eyes."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She's pretty interestin'. —I gotta make my 
debut soon too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroooom...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ... Hello, manage-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What is it? I told you not to call today 
'cause of the race, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
""My, what are you getting so worked up 
about? I only wanted to share my thoughts 
on the race.""

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"First of all, great job. It was a 
wonderful race. You completely lived up to 
the fans' expectations. Displaying such a 
gorgeous run, you—"

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: “—It was truly beautiful.”

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Keep excelling on the Tiara path and show 
off even more of your brilliance. It will 
definitely be a plus for your modeling 
career too."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"You're aiming for the Triple Tiara, 
right? I'm looking forward to it. Well 
then, do your best."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ... Exactly.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I act like a 'living doll' myself, then 
of course people will only look at my 
appearance.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just a pretty doll with no will of her 
own, in other words.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The reason I chose the Hanshin JF was 
because I wanted to live up to the fans' 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“All I did was show the people who wanted 
to see a pretty me exactly what they 
wanted.”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just like modeling. In the end, it wasn't 
a path I chose for myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you just do whatever anyone tells you, 
of course nothin' is gonna change...
choice_data_list:
You just wanted to live up to 
expectations.

You just wanted to live up to 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So what? Are you saying we had no 
choice?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"That's no good, then. Sure, I want to 
make the fans happy, but..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I want to choose that method 
myself. Even if it means betraying 
everyone... If I don't betray them, I 
can't get what I want."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want to make everyone acknowledge me... 
on the path I chose for myself!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"So I've made up my mind. I'm not going 
down the Tiara path."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the pinnacle of Umamusume. 
Taking on the Classic Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside the Tiara route is the 
Classic Triple Crown, consisting of the 
Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka 
Sho."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It is the most quintessential of royal 
roads, and the Umamusume who wins the 
Derby in particular will etch her name 
into history."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You might have made a plan for me to 
win on the Tiara route, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Can I just flip it all upside down?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not thanking you just yet. I told 
you from the start that I'm selfish.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I'll show you with my actions. 
I'll give you the title of Derby Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To take first place in the hottest race. 
And then--

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Through my running, through this way! I'll 
make them acknowledge me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that we would aim 
for the Satsuki Sho, the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown!
